cloud.title: Nimly account
cloud.description: Sign in with the account you use in the official app.

location.title: Location
location.description: Choose which location to expose in Home Assistant.

mirror.title: Nimly mirror
mirror.description:
Pick the real lock (paired in ZHA) and the MQTT prefix the emulator uses.

{detected}

channels.title: Mirror channels
channels.description: Choose what should be mirrored between the Nimly app side and the real lock.

custom.title: Custom channels
custom.description: Enable one channel at a time.

abort.already_configured: This account or lock is already configured.
abort.provisioned: The bridge is provisioned and connected.
abort.no_address: Could not read the device address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the vendor cloud.
error.provision_failed: Provisioning failed – check the network and try again.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to ask the account for new activity. Shorter is more responsive and asks more of the vendor's API.

channels.title: Mirror channels
channels.description: Change what is mirrored. Each channel also has a switch you can toggle later.

slot_set_pin.title: Set a PIN
slot_set_pin.description: The code is written to the lock and never stored in Home Assistant.

slot_clear.title: Clear a slot
slot_clear.description: Clears the credential on the lock and forgets the slot's local data.

progress.slot_set_pin: Sending the PIN to the lock...

error.lock_unreachable: The lock did not respond. Press a button on the lock to wake it and try again.

pin_required_remote.name: Cloud PIN required for remote unlock

new_slot.title: Slot {slot} needs a name
new_slot.description: A {kind} is registered in slot {slot}. Give the user a name so Home Assistant notifications show the right person.

init.title: Name slot {slot}
init.description: Enter the name of the person using slot {slot}.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Ask the account for new activity right now.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which account to refresh. Leave out for all of them.

fetch_history.name: Fetch activity history
fetch_history.description: Return the activities Home Assistant has collected, newest first.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Limit the result to one lock.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of activities to return.

set_lock.name: Lock or unlock through the cloud
set_lock.description: An optional second control path. The local path is faster and keeps working without internet.

locked.name: Locked
locked.description: True to lock, false to unlock.

gateway_scan.name: Open the bridge pairing window
gateway_scan.description: Asks the bridge to accept a new device, so a module or an emulator can join from Home Assistant.

start.name: Start
start.description: True to open the window, false to close it.

probe.name: Call the vendor API (diagnostics)
probe.description: Calls paths on the vendor API and returns the status and a redacted body. Used to map the API; not needed for normal use.

paths.name: Paths
paths.description: Paths relative to the API root, or objects with path, method, json and headers.

set_ieee.name: Provision IEEE address
set_ieee.description: Sends an IEEE address to the emulator, which stores it in NVS and reboots. Defaults to the real lock module's own address, because the vendor cloud only accepts known modules.

ieee.name: IEEE address
ieee.description: Address in the form 00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77. Empty uses the lock's own.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to provision. Leave out to target all of them.

ota_install.name: Install bridge firmware (OTA)
ota_install.description: Sends a firmware URL to the bridge, which downloads it, writes the next application partition and reboots. Used by the update entity, but can also be run manually.

url.name: URL
url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to the application binary.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which bridge to update. Leave out to target all of them.

provision_wifi.name: Provision Wi-Fi (BLE/Improv)
provision_wifi.description: Connects to the bridge over Bluetooth and sends Wi-Fi credentials using Improv. Used by the discovery flow, but can also be run manually.

address.name: Bluetooth address
address.description: The device's BLE address, for example from nRF Connect or from discovery.

ssid.name: Network (SSID)
ssid.description: The Wi-Fi network the bridge should join.

set_slot_name.name: Name a lock slot
set_slot_name.description: Stores a person's name for a lock slot so events and notifications say who did what.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The lock slot the credential lives in.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to name a slot on. Leave out to target all of them.

set_pin.name: Write a PIN to a slot
set_pin.description: Writes a PIN code to the real lock and names the slot. The code is never stored in Home Assistant.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The slot to write the code to.

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional person name for the slot.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

clear_slot.name: Clear a lock slot
clear_slot.description: Clears the credential on the lock and forgets the slot's local data.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.
